name: us-recalls-mcp
description: US product recalls from FDA (food, drugs, devices), NHTSA (vehicles) and CPSC (consumer products).
long_description: Live access to official US product recalls: FDA food, drug and device enforcement reports (openFDA), NHTSA vehicle and equipment recalls, and CPSC consumer product recalls. Search, recent recalls, vehicle recalls by make/model/year and recall details. No API key needed.

tools.name: search_recalls
tools.description: Search official US recalls by keyword/brand across FDA, NHTSA and CPSC.

tools.name: recent_recalls
tools.description: Latest official US recalls from the last N days (no keyword), newest first.

tools.name: vehicle_recalls
tools.description: Complete NHTSA recall history for one vehicle (make, model, model year), newest first.

tools.name: recall_details
tools.description: Full record for one recall by its official ID (untrimmed text, plus extra source fields in "raw").
